crossRefs.note: They will no longer each teach his neighbor, and every man teach his brother, saying, ‘Know Yahweh;’ for they will all…
They will not teach every man his fellow citizen, and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know…

translations.web: You will say everyone to his neighbor, and everyone to his brother, ‘What has Yahweh answered?’ and, ‘What has Yahweh said?’
translations.bsb: This is what each man is to say to his friend and to his brother: ‘What has the LORD answered?’ or ‘What has the LORD spoken?’
translations.kjv: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
translations.asv: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbor, and every one to his brother, What hath Jehovah answered? and, What hath Jehovah spoken?
